# `tfctl profile profiles create`

The `tfctl profile profiles create` command creates a new named profile.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles create NAME [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile profiles create` command creates a new named profile. By default, the newly created profile is automatically activated. Use the `--no-activate` flag to prevent automatic activation.

Profile names start with a letter and may contain lower case letters a-z, upper case letters A-Z, digits 0-9, and underscores '_'. The maximum length for a profile name is 64 characters.

## Arguments

- `NAME`: (Required) The name of the profile to create. Refer to [Profile naming rules] for more information.

## Available options

The `tfctl profile profiles create` command supports the following options.

| Option | Description | Default | Required |
|--------|-------------|---------|----------|
| `--hostname=NAME` | HCP Terraform / Terraform Enterprise hostname. | `app.terraform.io` | No |
| `--no-activate` | Disables automatic activation of the newly created profile. | `false` (profile is activated by default) | No |

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Profile naming rules

Profile names must follow these rules:

- Start with a letter (a-z, A-Z)
- Contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), digits (0-9), and underscores (_)
- Have a maximum length of 64 characters

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to create a new named profile.

### Create a new profile

The following example creates a new profile with the specified name and activates it. Replace `<PROFILE_NAME>` with a valid profile name.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles create <PROFILE_NAME>
```

### Create a profile for Terraform Enterprise

The following example creates a new profile with a custom hostname. Replace `<PROFILE_NAME>` with a valid profile name and `<HOSTNAME>` with a valid HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise hostname.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles create <PROFILE_NAME> --hostname <HOSTNAME>
```

### Create a profile without activating it

The following example creates a new profile with the specified name without activating it. Replace `<PROFILE_NAME>` with a valid profile name.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles create <PROFILE_NAME> --no-activate
```
